game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool, a still ritual pool: the tomb cartographer must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool: a still ritual pool
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Declare char: declare resource as char, apply resource + 68, and print each result with %c. Dataset 3 starts with [0, 1, 2, 3]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ritual Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the glyph door using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The glyph door reached with actions_used <= 22.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the glyph door is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Declare before use. char resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %c.
